decisions.reason: Restates 순박한 산골 사람인 그는 as a natural English clause instead of a Korean-shaped appositive, without changing meaning.
거칠 것 없이 is unhindered/unrestrained living; SOL’s “to fear” over-specifies and weakly sets up the 양해 beat.
실룩거린다 is already quivering; “in motion” is redundant.
나름 대접한다고 내온 is hospitality brought out, not making the meal “special”; watery is the natural rendering of 희멀건 국.
Restores omitted 반면 as “meanwhile,” and “kept” matches 계속 떠들어 댔다.
Same-chapter 천하제일 is already “under heaven” (P173); SOL’s “in the world” breaks that rendering.
띠링 is a system chime; “Ding!” is the natural English sound-effect, and “Ding.” is not an improvement.
Keeps the source dash-list System panel, established quest italics, and 생성되었습니다 as “generated”; SOL’s prose/bold/created swap is convention churn.
Restores the shocked stutter 저, 저게 that BASE flattens into a calm yes/no question.
윗물에서 노는 놈들 is casual narrator idiom; “big shots up top” / “figured” fit Taekyung better than genteel “upper circles.”
템빨로 먹고 들어가다 is a gear head start; BASE adds unstated “rely on.”
일이 잘 풀렸으니 나야 좋지만 is glad things worked out; SOL’s “in my favor” adds self-interest.
